records.title: ToolDreamer: Instilling LLM Reasoning Into Tool Retrievers
records.reason: ToolDreamer improves tool retrieval by reasoning over user requests and tool descriptions. It addresses agent tool-selection quality, not transformer inference efficiency.

records.title: Avant-Garde: Empowering GPUs with Scaled Numeric Formats
records.reason: ACM publisher full text was not accessible in this session. Metadata describes GPU support for scaled numeric formats (FP8/MX) and performance-density costs, directly adjacent to shared-microexponent hardware, but primary methods and inference evaluation could not be checked.

records.title: PARQ: Piecewise-Affine Regularized Quantization
records.reason: PARQ develops a piecewise-affine regularizer and aggregate proximal optimizer for quantization-aware training; experiments cover convolutional and transformer vision tasks. It is a general quantization algorithm but tested only in vision/QAT, not LLM inference.

records.title: Skrr: Skip and Re-use Text Encoder Layers for Memory Efficient Text-to-Image Generation
records.reason: Skrr skips and reuses text-encoder layers to reduce memory/computation in text-to-image diffusion. Its full text measures T2I quality and compute, but the target is diffusion text encoders rather than language-model serving; keep as a cross-domain memory-efficient encoder method.

records.title: Beyond Next Token Prediction: Patch-Level Training for Large Language Models
records.reason: Patch-level training aggregates multiple tokens to cut LLM pretraining cost to about half, then uses token-level training to align inference behavior. It is explicitly a training-cost method and introduces no inference-time efficiency improvement.
